description: Run `agentgov verify-receipt` with 'args' (paths relative to this directory) and expect 'exit'. 0 pass, 3 malformed, 4 receipt signature, 5 log inclusion, 6 witness, 8 rows, 9 relay attestation, 10 action binding.

cases.name: committed-refund
cases.description: a committed refund, witnessed, with two of its three rows disclosed

cases.name: refused-tenant-wipe
cases.description: a refused 229-row cross-tenant plan: refusals get receipts too

cases.name: scoped-repair
cases.description: a scoped plan that repairs the refused one (decision.repair_of)

cases.name: recovered-commit
cases.description: a commit resolved after a crash from its commit marker

cases.name: halted-scope
cases.description: admitted by every check, refused because the scope was halted

cases.name: internal-hmac
cases.description: a bare receipt signed with an internal HMAC key

cases.name: field-modified
cases.description: settled_usd lowered after signing

cases.name: forged-signature
cases.description: re-signed by another key that claims the issuer's key_id

cases.name: alg-confusion
cases.description: an HMAC keyed with the issuer's public key, claiming hmac-sha256

cases.name: checkpoint-forged
cases.description: the checkpoint's tree size edited after signing

cases.name: reordered-log
cases.description: the log operator swapped two leaves and signed the new root

cases.name: leaf-moved
cases.description: the same swap, with a valid audit path to the receipt's new index: only the position signed into the receipt catches it

cases.name: unwitnessed
cases.description: a real checkpoint the witness never saw

cases.name: split-view
cases.description: a forked log: a different receipt 6 under a signed root no witness cosigned

cases.name: row-modified
cases.description: a disclosed row edited after commitment

cases.name: row-moved
cases.description: a disclosed row presented at another index

cases.name: rows-of-another-receipt
cases.description: a valid disclosure, of a different receipt

cases.name: duplicate-key
cases.description: a duplicate object key

cases.name: float-amount
cases.description: a float where a decimal string belongs

cases.name: unknown-field
cases.description: a field the schema does not define

cases.name: refund-call
cases.description: the action receipt, with the outbox row of the request it committed disclosed

cases.name: refund-delivered
cases.description: the delivery receipt: witnessed, attested by the relay, bound to the action

cases.name: attestation-forged
cases.description: an attestation signed by another key that claims the relay's key id

cases.name: payload-swapped
cases.description: a payload hash the relay never attested, re-signed by the log

cases.name: unknown-relay
cases.description: a real delivery, checked against a key that is not its relay's

cases.name: wrong-action
cases.description: a delivery re-bound to another receipt's leaf hash, re-signed by the log

cases.name: status-modified
cases.description: the sink's answer edited after signing

cases.name: delivered-before-action
cases.description: a delivery that claims a place before the action it follows from

cases.name: v12-sealed
cases.description: signature version 2: a receipt under the outgoing key's last checkpoint, checked with that key alone

cases.name: v12-early
cases.description: a receipt of the outgoing key's era, under the incoming key's checkpoint, followed from the outgoing key

cases.name: v12-late
cases.description: a receipt of the incoming key, followed from the outgoing key

cases.name: v12-late-both-keys
cases.description: the same receipt, with both keys trusted outright

cases.name: v12-late-unfollowed
cases.description: the incoming key's receipt, without the transition that names its key

cases.name: v12-forged-transition
cases.description: a transition to another key, signed by it, claiming the issuer's key id

cases.name: v12-downgraded
cases.description: a version 2 signature presented as version 1

cases.name: v12-unknown-version
cases.description: a signature version that does not exist

cases.name: v12-old-key-past-its-era
cases.description: the outgoing key signs a checkpoint past the size it handed over

cases.description: a receipt naming only the plan's own tenant, and counting three others

cases.description: a measurement class that does not exist

cases.description: quantities out of order
